subject: tf-sh
title: (R)TF.SH.------WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart on book p. 222 (WAC-20). TF-SH (transfer shifts) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From ALT-C-PG: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). From PROJ-DY: AFL (affinity alignment). From EXP-DYM: INFO-DE (information degrees). From AFL: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From INFO-DE: MTH (methodology) and IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism).
